book.name: 1Qoronttoosa
book.title: Phawuloosa Qoronttoosa Asayis Xaafeez Tiina Kiita

content: Tinbbitennee duma duma doonar odintto
Siiqo kaalloytta. Ayyana imotita miinthii koyoytta; ubbapp aathii, tinbbite imota miinthii koyoytta.
Duma duma doonar odinttiza asii Xoossayis odizapp attin asis odooya. Zini asis qonccekka xuura Ayyana wolqqar odinttiza gishos oonkka E odinttizana akaakooya.
Zini tinbbite odizitay as dichchodayis, minthathodayisinnee xaalisodayis asis odiza.
Duma duma doonar odiza as fana dichchiza. Zini tinbbite odiza as woosa keeth dichchiza.

Yi ubbay duma duma doonar odinttizako ta dosiza, zin tinbbite odizako ta usa dosiza. Duma duma doonar odinttizana woosa keeth dichchis bili7iz as dhabiko, duma duma doona odinttizaypp tinbbite odizay aadhiza.
Zin ta ishuntho, taanii yinttiko yhanigii qonccithar woy eratithar woy tinbbite odor woy timirtte bayth duma duma doonar odenttiko yinttan ab maaddodee?
Duma duma yeth miishayis pettii girssi yeziko, shulishulo girssinne diith girssi wayizii shaakkii erodee?
Ma tulitulo pugo shaakkii erinttaam ixxiko olas giiginttizay oonoo?
Yey garkkekka, duma duma doonar yi odinttizay qoncce maaqqaam ixxiko yi odiza oonii erodee? Yeyi carkkor odinttizay garkke.
Yha alamel gaame doonitay yeza; ye ubbayis bili7ithii yeza.
Zini pettii as odinttiza doona taanii eraam ixxiko E taas imathe maaqqiza; taakka ees imathe maaqqiza.
Yey garkkekka, Geeshsha Ayyana imota yi ekkodayis miinthii koyko, woosa keeth dichchayis ubbapp aadhiz imota koyoytta.
Duma duma doonar odinttiza as fa oda bilodayis birshshith imotay ingginttoday garkk Xooss woosso.
Taanii duma duma doonar Xooss woossiko, ta ayyanay woossiza, zin ta wozinay akkokka maadinttooya.
Yeezin, ta ab oothodayis koshshee? Taanii ta ayyanar woosiza; ta kahayirakka woosiza. Taanii ta ayyanar yexxiza; ta kahayirakka yexxiza.
Yeya maaqqaam ixxiko neenii ne ayyanar Xooss galatiza wode ye aqayid neenii giza erekka as ne galatiza wode, «Amin77ii» gode?
Neenii Xooss galatizay lo77o, zin hara as maaddooya.
Ta yi ubbaypp aathii duma duma doonar odinttiza gishos Xooss galatiza.
Zini taanii woosa keetha harita tamaarssodayis duma duma doonar taphphii mukulo qaala odinttizaypp erinttiza doonar ichchin qaala odo dosiza.
Ta ishuntho, yi iita qofas na7itay garkk maaqqoyttap attin qopar na7a maaqqipatte wozinaamita maaqqoytta.
Goday, Geeshsha Maxaafayid,

content.text: Zini yeyi haninikka tana si7ooya» yeegiza.

content: Yikkee, duma duma doonar oday, ammanoowa asayis malla maaqqinepp attin ammaniza asayis baaya. Tinbbite ammaniza asayis malla maaqqinepp attin ammanoowa asayis baaya.
Woosa keeth asay pettipp shiiqeez wode ubbay duma duma doonar odinttiko eroowa woy ammanoowa asay yi shiiqo yi7ii, «Yhayttitay eeyiza» goosane?
Zini eroowa woy ammanoowa asay woosa keeth geliza wode asay tinbbite ododar, si7iko fa nagara akaakoda; ma E si7eez qaalayid pirddinttoda.
Unttii e wozina geemmeez qofa qonccisoda. Yey garkkekka, «Tuma Xoossay yi gancce yeza» yeegii markkattii, xuggunii Xoossayis goynnoda.
Goynno woga

Ta ishuntho, nu waago? Yi pettipp shiiqiza wode pettayis mazmuure yeza; pettayis taamarsso imotay yeza; pettayis qonccithii yeza; pettayis duma duma doonar odintto yeza; pettayis bili7iz imotay yeza. Ye ubbay woosa keethana dichchizabaz maaqqodayis beeziza.
Duma duma doonar odinttiza asitay yeziko, nam7e woy ganggiko hayidz maaqqiko maarar maarar naaginttii ododayis beeziza. Unttii odinttizana hara as billo.
Zini billiz as dhabiko, duma duma doonar odinttizay woosa keetha si77i go. Faasinnee fa Xoossayis odo.
Tinbbite odizitay nam7e woy hayidz maaqqii odo. Ma yhankkitay unttii gizibaz shaakko.
Ye shiiqayid yez hara asis pettibaz qoncciko tiina odinttizay si77i go.
Ubbay tamaaroday garkkennee ubbay miinggoday garkk maarar maarar tinbbite ododayis danda7iza.
Nabitay ayyanay nabitayis azazinttiza.
Xoossay sarotith Xoossapp attin cabbo Xooss baaya. Geeshshitay woosa keethitay ubbay yey garkke.
Maachchitay woosa keeth shiiqo si77i go. Higge gizay garkk unttii haarinttopp attin woosa keetha ododayis unttis mawute baaya.
Maachchitay woosa keetha odintto borsso maaqqeez gishos pettii pettibaz erodayis koyko kara fa azina oyco.
Xooss qaala tiina yi ke7eenee? Woy Xooss qaalay yi aaddako ye7eenee?
Oonkka fana nabe woy fana Xooss as gi qoppiko, taanii yinttis xaafeezay Goday azazo maaqqeezana akaako.
Zini oonkka eraam ixxiko eekka erinttippe.
Yeyi gishos, ta ishuntho, tinbbite ododayis miinthii amottoytta; ma duma duma doonar odinttaka kayppate.
Zini ubbaykka wogarannee maarar maaqqo.
